metas.description:
2023
A singer with amnesia meets a busker. They collaborate, but she knows more of his past than she lets on.

metas.name: Kaatrinile Varum Geetham
metas.description:
1978
Mohan loves Kamini but her father kills her after learning about their relationship. Distressed, he goes on a trip where he meets Rosy, a lookalike of his former lover, and falls for her.

metas.name: Mann
metas.description:
2006
Lakshmi, a young student, is engaged to be married to Raja, who is a family friend. But her life changes when she falls in love with Ponrasa, her classmate.
